title: Quantum-Seeded Distributed Post-Quantum Group Signatures for 5G V2X Communications
summary: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications rely on elliptic-curve signatures that a quantum adversary breaks and on pseudonym certificates whose anonymity rests on rotation rate, not cryptography. This work presents qDGSP, a post-quantum V2X infrastructure: a hash-based dynamic group signature scheme (DGSP, over SPHINCS+ and WOTS+) distributed between a central controller and roadside verifiers.
